content.short: Dock is an identity tooling platform where data is fraud-proof and instantly verifiable on the blockchain.
content.description: Dock provides a practical foundation for decentralized identity by helping organizations dramatically reduce the cost and time associated with data verification, while streamlining the processes used to validate and issue digital credentials. For individuals, Dock puts control of personal data in their hands, enabling private, consent-driven access to a wide range of products and services without unnecessary exposure. Since 2018, Dock has been a recognized leader in decentralized digital identity technology, earning the trust of organizations across healthcare, finance, education, and other industries.
